subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should maintainers sponsor this secure Tailscale onboarding direction by rebasing it onto current main, or narrow/close it now that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98868 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100317 already changed the same first-run pairing surfaces?
rationale: The branch is proof-positive but conflicts with newer maintainer-reviewed onboarding and Tailnet route behavior, and the right conflict resolution is a product/security choice rather than a deterministic cleanup close.

options.title: Sponsor the rebase
options.body: Resolve conflicts on current main, keep the PR's secure Tailscale chooser, and preserve the later branded onboarding plus reachable-route setup-code behavior.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Keep only the auth-copy or raw-IP-blocking pieces that are still missing after comparing against current main, and drop the broader onboarding rewrite.

options.title: Pause or close as superseded
options.body: If current main's refreshed onboarding and setup-code fallback route behavior is considered sufficient, close this branch without landing its separate chooser.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts on current main, keep the PR's secure Tailscale chooser, and preserve the later branded onboarding plus reachable-route setup-code behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the conflicting onboarding refresh and authored this branch, so they have the clearest path to rebase or narrow the overlapping iOS flow.
